label: Reload
description: Watch the tree and serve it again when a document changes. Meant for development: a project names it in its startup list, before whatever listens, and an edit takes effect without a restart. It judges the tree the way `wilanis check` does and serves it only when it is clean, so a half-written document never becomes what answers. Only a `.json` file counts as a change, and never one under `.wilanis/` (the tree's own working state: the @auth files store writes sessions there, and a sign-in is not an edit), `scenarios/` (what `wilanis fuzz` records), `node_modules/`, `dist/` or `.git/`.

debounceMs.description: how long to wait for the edits to stop before reloading, in milliseconds; default 120
